title: The balanced-graph conjecture for flat graphs is false
scope: An actual finite simple undirected K3,3 is flat (every edge lies in at most two triangles), but its actual unordered clique counts are c0=1,c1=6,c2=9 and all higher zero. Odd total 6, inclusive even total 10, positive even total 9; discrepancies 4 and 3 refute both conventions. No planarity/no-isolated-edge restriction inserted.
source_targets: Hossein Teimoori Faal, On Clique Roots of Flat Graphs, arXiv2112.09721v1, Definition2.2/equation14/Conjecture2
substantive_reason: Refutes the exact published universal balanced-flat-graph conjecture with its actual graph and clique semantics. Independent reviews found no complete applicable earlier-result reduction. Smallness or elementary counting alone is not an exclusion. The separate public Conjecture1 counterpart does not subsume this Conjecture2 endpoint.
